com.empline/tool-documentation.access: Requires OAuth consent for the selected operation action. Supported action-specific scopes: store:prices:write, store:listings:drafts:write, store:inventory:write, store:listings:drafts:submit, account:saved_searches:write, account:watchlist:write, store:orders:tracking:write, store:listings:publish, store:imports:resume. The selected action determines which scopes are required; this inventory is not a request for all scopes. Pricing reads require store:prices:write, listing.draft.update requires store:listings:drafts:write, inventory.adjust requires store:inventory:write, listing.draft.submit requires store:listings:drafts:submit, and account.saved_search.change requires independent account:saved_searches:write. Seller activity rechecks approved ownership and EDIT_LISTINGS; buyer activity rechecks the current account and its own grant without seller authority. Records remain isolated by actor, applicable store, grant, environment and action.
com.empline/tool-documentation.effects: Reads durable activity and local results without resuming execution. An explicit pricing reconcile_channel may perform the documented read-only provider probe.
com.empline/tool-documentation.failures: Foreign, revoked or expired grants and stale versions fail. Unapproved plans require web review. Idempotency-key reuse for another plan conflicts; a lost response is recovered through supercatch_list_operations or supercatch_get_operation before any new action.
com.empline/tool-documentation.notFor: No inventory, order, automation settings or listing publication changes. Local completion does not establish marketplace prices.
com.empline/tool-documentation.purpose: Find pricing operations owned by this connection and store, optionally by the original client idempotency key after losing an initial response. Live pages use bound cursors; previous grants and other stores remain inaccessible.
com.empline/tool-documentation.returns: Returns a concrete pricing, listing.draft.update , inventory.adjust listing.draft.submit or account.saved_search.change operation/history envelope selected by the read action. Inventory receipts confirm local stock/history only, not provider inventory.
com.empline/tool-documentation.useWhen: Recover or inspect an operation without resuming execution. Omit action for legacy pricing; set action to listing.draft.update for saved photo drafts , inventory.adjust for native stock corrections, listing.draft.submit for frozen internal review submissions, or account.saved_search.change for separate buyer saved-search receipts.
